statement: Nvidia is in advanced talks to invest several hundred million dollars in Cloverleaf Infrastructure, a developer of powered data-center land with more than 7 gigawatts sold and a pipeline above 10 gigawatts.
why: Power and grid interconnection are the binding constraint on new AI capacity, and Nvidia is buying into that upstream bottleneck to keep chip deployment moving.

impact.mechanism: Securing powered land ahead of demand shortens the wait between chip availability and energized racks, easing an upstream long-lead constraint.

evidence.source: Yahoo Finance (citing Wall Street Journal reporting)
evidence.excerpt: has sold projects representing more than 7 gigawatts of powered land to data-centre developers

evidence.source: Yahoo Finance (citing Wall Street Journal reporting)
evidence.excerpt: grid interconnection queues and utility permitting timelines remain a persistent bottleneck

confidence.basis: Secondary reporting of an unannounced deal; no filing or company confirmation.
